basic_info.description: The Sutterfield, a 17-story condominium building in San Francisco's Lower Pacific Heights, was designed by Backen Arrigoni & Ross Architects.  Centrally located: 0.4 miles to Japan town, 0.4 miles to local parks (Lafayette Park and Jefferson Square Park), 0.5 miles to House of Prime Rib, 0.5 mile to UCSF Saint Francis Hospital, 0.7 miles to Davies Symphony Hall, etc.  It was completed in 1993 and offers a mix of residential and mixed-use features. Residents enjoy numerous building amenities including 24-hr doorman security, common area wifi, gym, hot tub, sauna, indoor parking and an outdoor courtyard.   Situated on the 12th floor, this unit features breathtaking city views through newly replaced floor-to-ceiling double paned windows. The entire unit was custom painted in 2024, adding a fresh and modern touch to a move in ready view home, ready for the next owner. Stackup washer and dryer included in this spacious corner unit.
